question: A potentiometer is used to determine the internal resistance of a $1.5 \text{ V}$ cell. The balance point of the cell in open circuit is found to be $76.3 \text{ cm}$. When a resistor of $9.5 \, \Omega$ is used in the external circuit of the cell, the balance point shifts to $64.8 \text{ cm}$. Determine the internal resistance of the cell.
